shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' pages/_app.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' pages/_document.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' pages/_error.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' pages/404.js"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' pages/api/posts/index.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' pages/api/posts/[id].js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' components/AppProvider.js && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' styles/globals.css && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' tsconfig.json && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-static-params.mdx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/not-found.mdx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/use-router.mdx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.mdx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"next/head|next/router|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|_app|_document|_error|router\\.isFallback|pages/api|pages/\" -S app components styles next.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json . || true"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' app/layout.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/blog/page.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' app/blog/[id]/page.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/not-found.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/error.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' app/api/posts/route.ts && echo '---' && sed -n '1,340p' app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' components/AppProvider.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,220p' components/BackButton.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' styles/globals.css && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' types/blog.ts"
